note: What the administration app offers each identity of the backend's endpoint table, and what each offer calls. identities: the token claims (resource_access per client) of each identity, the same users as the backend's test realm (the guard fe/scripts/endpoint-roles.test.mjs holds them to be/niord/src/test/resources/keycloak/niord-realm.json), and the session domain it sits in. components: each gated component endpoint-roles.spec.ts renders, the state it is rendered in, and per item (its label key) the endpoints it calls and the identities it is shown to; the spec fails on an item shown that is not here or a shownTo that differs, the guard fails on an identity shown an item an endpoint refuses it, unless the item names that identity under knownFaults with the backlog line that records the fault (and then fails once the refusal is gone). notRendered: each other file that gates on a role, and why the spec does not render it.

MenuService.state: the main navigation; an area's own calls are not counted here (its route guard admits the same roles)

MessageDetailsMenu.state: a message of the session domain's series, a tag remembered, the message in another tag

TagPicker.state: the Tag filter's picker (filter mode, Manage on), which every identity opens; Manage, offered with the domain's user role, opens the tag manager, whose calls are those of messages.shell.action.tagManage

UserField.state: the messages' User filter field (user-filter-panel.html), which the filter menu offers to every signed-in account; its search of the user directory as the user types is enabled only with the domain's user role (the item: the search field), while Me sets the account's own user for every signed-in account
